subject: 现存金堂
author: Chainwit.
source_note: 现存金堂于庆长八年（1603）再建，属于桃山时期的寺院木构。 图版聚焦金堂，不以东寺五重塔或讲堂替代。
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is the actual monument PHOTO and controls geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project black fine-contour STYLE sample; never transfer its Buddha subject. Draw the named Japanese building accurately as a complete, isolated elevation at nearly frontal view. Fine sparse black ink contours with a few structural lines; no broad dark fills, hatching, pencil grain or opaque silhouettes. Pure flat opaque WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, including every blank region inside and outside the subject. Center with generous margins. No shadow, gradient, texture, glow, checkerboard, color, text, labels, signage, people, foliage, surrounding buildings, watermark or frame. Subject: To-ji Kondo Golden Hall, the ACTUAL existing 1603 main hall, distinct from To-ji five-story pagoda and lecture hall. Preserve large upper roof above lower skirt roof, central raised entrance and timber lattice facade; remove people, event banners, tents and trees.
